text: It changes a lot through the year. Almaty has quite hot, dry summers, but the winters can be pretty harsh, with snow and temperatures well below zero. Spring and autumn are short but beautiful, especially when the mountains are still covered in snow.

tips.en: A general answer first, then summer and winter separately.
tips.kk: Алдымен жалпы жауап, сосын жаз бен қыс бөлек.
tips.ru: Сначала общий ответ, потом лето и зима по отдельности.
tips.example: Almaty has quite hot, dry summers

tips.en: But shows the climate is varied.
tips.example: but the winters can be pretty harsh

note.en: Specifies when it is most beautiful.

questions.followUp: Which season do you like most?
questions.question: What is the weather usually like where you live?

text: I'm happiest when it's sunny but not too hot — around twenty degrees is perfect for me. That kind of weather makes me want to go outside and walk everywhere, whereas when it's grey and rainy for days, I find it much harder to stay motivated.

tips.en: A specific temperature instead of just “warm”.
tips.example: around twenty degrees is perfect for me

tips.en: Contrasts favourite weather with disliked weather.
tips.example: whereas when it's grey and rainy for days

questions.question: What kind of weather do you like best?

text: Definitely. In winter, when it gets dark by five o'clock, I tend to feel a bit tired and less sociable. As soon as spring arrives, though, I have much more energy and I'm always making plans to meet friends outdoors.

tips.en: Winter and spring as two examples prove the “yes”.
tips.kk: Қыс пен көктем екі мысал ретінде — жауап «иә» дегенді дәлелдейді.
tips.ru: Зима и весна как два примера — ответ доказывает «да».
tips.example: when it gets dark by five o'clock

tips.en: An exact time linker: immediately when.
tips.ru: Точная связка времени: сразу, как только.

questions.question: Does the weather affect your mood?

text: Pretty much every morning, mainly to decide what to wear. The weather in Almaty can change really quickly, so it's easy to get caught in the rain without an umbrella. I use an app on my phone, and to be fair, it's usually quite reliable.

tips.en: Not just “yes” but why — to choose clothes.
tips.kk: Жай «иә» емес, не үшін екені де — киім таңдау.
tips.ru: Не только «да», но и зачем — выбрать одежду.
tips.example: mainly to decide what to wear

tips.en: Explains why the forecast matters in this city.
tips.kk: Болжамның дәл осы қалада неге маңызды екенін түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Объясняет, почему прогноз важен именно в этом городе.
tips.example: so it's easy to get caught in the rain

note.en: An idiom: be outside when it starts raining.

questions.question: Do you check the weather forecast often?

text: I think so, yes. Older people often say that winters used to be much snowier, and in the last few summers we've had some unusually hot weeks. I'm not an expert, but it seems to be part of the wider changes in climate that we hear about in the news.

tips.en: The answer uses what older people say and personal observation.
tips.kk: Жауап үлкендердің сөзіне және өз байқауына сүйенеді.
tips.ru: Ответ опирается на слова старших и собственные наблюдения.
tips.example: Older people often say that winters used to be much snowier

tips.en: I’m not an expert, but is an honest hedge before the conclusion.
tips.kk: I’m not an expert, but — қорытынды алдындағы шынайы ескерту.
tips.ru: I’m not an expert, but — честная оговорка перед выводом.

note.en: A past state that is no longer true.

questions.followUp: Why do you think that is?
questions.question: Has the weather in your country changed in recent years?
